title: Sharkys
author: Jansar25
desc: **Sharkys** is a dynamic 6-week workout program designed for intermediate lifters looking to build muscle and strength. With 30 sessions spread across the week, each workout lasts approximately 70 minutes and utilizes a variety of equipment commonly found in a garage gym. This program combines compound movements with targeted exercises to ensure balanced muscle development, focusing on both upper and lower body. Get ready to challenge yourself and achieve your fitness goals with this structured and effective training plan!
